_comment: Community defaults for the Forge engine's learnable parameters. RSI-learned overrides live in /Users/Shared/evolve/calibration/forge.json. Only values that have been locally calibrated need to appear there — missing keys fall through to these defaults.

critique_rounds._comment: Default number of build/critique cycles per forge run. RSI can adjust upward if more rounds consistently produce better-approved outputs. Per-app constraints.critique_rounds overrides this.

min_improvement_confidence._comment: Minimum effective detector confidence before a forge improvement run is triggered automatically. RSI adjusts this based on the ratio of approved vs. rejected forge runs. Higher = fewer but more reliable improvement runs.

outcome_stats._comment: Accumulated approval/rejection counts across all forge runs. Updated by forge_engine.py after each operator decision. Used by the RSI loop to adjust min_improvement_confidence.
